source: Ville de Québec: Arbres potentiellement remarquables (Service de l'environnement)
licence_proof: CKAN package_show API for this dataset: license_id: "cc-by", license_title: "Attribution (CC-BY 4.0)". Confirmed on the dataset's own metadata page as well: "Licence Attribution (CC-BY 4.0)", with a recommended citation naming Ville de Québec and Données Québec.
designation: "Arbres potentiellement remarquables": the city's own mapped inventory of trees flagged as potentially remarkable, tagged on the dataset itself with Arbre exceptionnel / Arbre patrimonial / Arbre remarquable. A real semantic designation, updated weekly per the dataset's own metadata (last modified 2026-08-09), not the city's bulk street-tree inventory.
attribution: Ville de Québec, Service de l'environnement
scope: All 685 features. Per-tree point coordinates (WGS84 lon/lat), already the right precision, no geocoding needed.
hard_rule_10_field: TYPE_PROP flags ownership directly: 594 of 685 are 'Privés' (private, various sub-flags for federal/provincial/private-maintenance land), only 76 are some form of 'Public' (60 plain Public, plus small Public:* subcategories). ONLY the Public-flagged subset should ever be considered for publication; the private majority stays in the file as data per CLAUDE.md's 'store everything, publish what clears the bar' but must never ship. This mirrors Brussels' register, which required the same filter.
vitality_field: None found in the schema (ID, TYPE_LIEU, NOM_LATIN, NOM_FRANCAIS, TYPE_ARBRE, DIAMETRE, POSITION_MESURE, MULTI_TRONC, DATE_PLANTE, TYPE_PROP, NOM_TOPOGRAPHIE). Alive-now is a per-tree check, as with every register scanned so far.
coordinate_note: Full precision per-tree point coordinates, no geocoding needed, the best-shaped coordinate data of anything found this pass.

cities_of_interest.Quebec City: All 685 rows are within Ville de Québec by definition (this is a municipal dataset); ~76 pass the public-land filter, comfortably above the 4-tree floor for a walkable-cluster city page.
cities_of_interest.note: DATE_PLANTE (planting date) is populated for some rows and would give a real age estimate for those; DIAMETRE (cm, at breast height per POSITION_MESURE=DHP) is the size field to sanity-check per the standing register-pitfalls rule before publishing any number.

properties.NOM_TOPOGRAPHIE: Parc linéaire des rivières St-Charles et du Berger
